question: What is the diameter of the road network? The diameter is the maximum shortest-path distance (in meters) over all ordered pairs of junctions (A, B) where a directed path from A to B exists. Exclude internal junctions (whose IDs start with ':'). Answer format: <number> rounded to 2 decimal places
